verdict.rationale: Dots is documented as an always-on cloud agent with its own computer that keeps working when the user's computer is off and uses background agents in parallel. The controls docs confirm recurring 'scheduled runs' that persist beyond pausing, and the getting-started docs give a weekday-9-AM recurring instruction, so autonomous recurring automation is first-party documented rather than just one-off tasks. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous background runs, detailed documentation of how schedules and triggers are configured and managed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Your dot is an always-on agent that keeps work moving across your tools and projects.
it can keep working even when your computer is off
It can use background agents to work on several things in parallel while you keep talking to it.
It doesn't stop every delegated task or cancel future scheduled runs.
Create a task in a Codex cloud environment you have already set up. Your computer can be offline.
